# Synthetic narrow-filter fixture using deliberately high but valid Q values.
Filter: ON LSC Fc 100 Hz Gain 6 dB Q 0.6
Filter 1: ON PK Fc 200 Hz Gain -2 dB Q 8
Filter 2: ON PK Fc 250 Hz Gain -3 dB Q 10
Filter 3: ON PK Fc 300 Hz Gain -4 dB Q 12
Filter 4: ON PK Fc 350 Hz Gain -5 dB Q 14
Filter 5: ON PK Fc 400 Hz Gain -6 dB Q 16
Filter 6: ON PK Fc 450 Hz Gain -5 dB Q 18
Filter 7: ON PK Fc 500 Hz Gain -4 dB Q 20
Filter 8: ON PK Fc 550 Hz Gain -3 dB Q 22
Filter 9: ON PK Fc 600 Hz Gain -2 dB Q 24
